test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of a tertiary activity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teaching**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Teaching** is a part of the **tertiary sector**, which includes activities that provide **services** to individuals and businesses.
 
• The tertiary sector is also known as the **service sector** and is focused on delivering **intangible goods** and services rather than producing material goods.
 
• Examples of tertiary activities include **education, healthcare, transportation, retail, banking, and entertainment services**.
 
• **Teachers** play a crucial role in **imparting knowledge**, developing skills, and shaping the future of individuals in society.
 
• The teaching profession is vital for fostering **human capital development**, which is essential for economic growth and innovation.
 
• Unlike primary and secondary activities, which are focused on **resource extraction and manufacturing**, tertiary activities contribute to the **social well-being** and economic stability of a region.
 
• Teaching is often associated with institutions such as **schools, colleges, universities, and training centers**.
 
• The service sector, including teaching, is increasingly important in modern economies due to the rise in demand for **knowledge-based professions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Manufacturing**__

 __
 
• **Manufacturing** is a part of the **secondary sector**, which involves the processing of raw materials into finished goods.
 
• Examples include the production of **automobiles, electronics, textiles, and machinery**.
 
• It contributes significantly to economic growth and industrialization.
 
 
 
• **Mining**__
 __
 
• **Mining** falls under the **primary sector**, which focuses on **resource extraction** directly from nature.
 
• Mining involves extracting **minerals, ores, and fossil fuels** such as coal, iron, and petroleum.
 
• It is essential for providing raw materials for various industries.
 
 
 
• **Farming**__
 
 
• **Farming** is a primary activity that involves **agriculture**, including the cultivation of crops and rearing of livestock.
 
• It is essential for producing **food and raw materials** for industries like textiles and food processing.
 
• Farming is one of the oldest and most fundamental economic activities.
